subject: mailbox
caption_template: a photo of <S*> mailbox in {color} color with a {material} surface
pixel_policy: Copy the ten reviewed RGB images and repaired binary masks byte for byte; relabel red to pink and magenta to purple without rerunning hue editing.
comparison_scope: The current SD1.5 Subject baseline already uses these ten color-by-material images. Experiment B changes their asymmetric glossy-painted-metal versus matte-plastic captions to symmetric metallic versus matte surface captions; it does not newly introduce a ten-image dataset.
limitations: One original pose, viewpoint, object mask and background; these data alone cannot establish disentanglement.
The accepted imagegen matte reference is a generated counterfactual, not ground-truth relighting; foreground details can differ.
Material appearance labels are reviewed supervision words, not measured BRDF ground truth.
